name: Sri Bhramaramba Malleswara Swamy Temple

location.address: Pedakakani, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh, India

history.summary: The 1961 Census of India volume records Sri Malleswaraswamy among the principal places of worship in Pedakakani. Guntur District tourism also identifies Pedakakani as a prominent temple area.

sources.title: Fairs and Festivals, Guntur, 1961 Census of India
sources.publisher: Office of the Registrar General, Census of India
sources.supports: Records Sri Malleswaraswamy as one of the main places of worship in Pedakakani.

sources.title: Tourism | Guntur District
sources.publisher: Government of Andhra Pradesh, Guntur District
sources.supports: Identifies Pedakakani as one of the district's prominent temple areas.
